_comment: The fan-out of the System 1 hook: questions asked once for each part of the human's message ({part} becomes the path of the part), and two helpers for the whole message. hook.py combines the answers (combine). Evidence: s1/research/2026-11-15-question-eval/README.md.
_replaces: The answers that hook.combine may write from the parts. Take an id out and the answer of its own question in questions.json reaches the line again. The hook reads this file on every prompt.

react.instructions: What does {part} do, in relation to the agent's last reply?

criteria.accepts: Accepts or approves what the agent did
criteria.corrects: Says the agent's work is wrong, incomplete or not what was asked
criteria.doubts: Questions or doubts what the agent did, without saying it is wrong
criteria.changes_request: Replaces, drops or reverses something the human asked for earlier
criteria.adds_request: Asks for something more, on top of what was asked
criteria.answers: Answers a question that the agent asked
criteria.asks_back: Leaves the agent's question open, or answers it with a question
criteria.new_topic: Starts something that has nothing to do with the agent's last reply

doubts.instructions: Does {part} doubt or question what the agent did?

criteria.true: Asks whether the agent really did something, why it did it that way, or shows surprise at it
criteria.false: Asks about the system or the task, not about the agent's own work

faults.instructions: Does {part} say that something the agent did is wrong, broken or missing?

criteria.true: Names a fault in the agent's own work, or says the work is not what was asked for
criteria.false: Reports a problem in another part of the system, changes what the human asked for, asks for more, asks a neutral question, or accepts the work

changes.instructions: Does {part} change what the human asked for before?

criteria.true: Replaces, drops or reverses an earlier request or preference
criteria.false: Continues the earlier request, corrects a mistake of the agent, or asks for something new

asks.instructions: Does {part} ask the agent a question about the task?

undecided.instructions: Does {part} say that the human does not know or has not decided something yet?

reverses.instructions: Does {part} take back or replace something that the human said earlier in the same message?

f_pasted.instructions: Is most of `message` pasted output, such as a log, an error trace or code?

f_open.instructions: Does `message` leave a question of the agent open, or answer it with a new question?

criteria.true: Says it does not know yet, or asks something back that must be settled first
criteria.false: Answers what the agent asked, or the agent asked nothing
